chaining: each model carries its own quota, so one account holds several separate pools; Free Tokens Only mode stops service at the quota and cannot accrue a charge

free_tier.stated: A one-time free inference quota per model, 500K tokens per model, granted to new users on registration. It is calculated separately for each model and shared under the primary account, offsets pay-as-you-go online inference tokens only, and in Free Tokens Only mode the service is suspended near the quota so no fee accrues. The activity page states the quota does not expire but is subject to change

limits.value: 500K tokens per model, one-time; offsets online pay-as-you-go inference only, not batch inference, plugins, knowledge bases or context-cache storage
unverified: per-model requests-per-minute and tokens-per-minute are not on the pages read

binding_note: the per-model 500K token quota is the only stated cap

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the quota page says to register and authenticate as a BytePlus user; the campaign terms state eligibility needs account registration and enterprise information submission, and that uniqueness is judged from email verification, ID documents, domain names, mobile numbers, devices and IP addresses. Whether a card is required at sign-up is not stated on the pages read

reliability_note: a separate Data Collaboration Rewards Campaign advertising up to 5M tokens daily per model behind corporate verification carried a stated end date of March 31, 2026
confidence_note: quota size and scope are documented; the identity requirement is unverified beyond the quoted terms
